name: Consignment 2
definition: Specifies the arrangement of the transport of goods and services and the parties involved in this process.

Consignor.name: Consignor
Consignor.definition: Party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering transport.

Consignee.name: Consignee
Consignee.definition: Party to which goods are consigned.

TransportMeans.name: Transport Means
TransportMeans.definition: Particular aircraft, vehicle, vessel or other device used for the transport of a consignment.
